title: Algo Grande Copper Announces Upsizing of Private Placement
description: VANCOUVER, BC / ACCESS Newswire / August 26, 2026 / Algo Grande Copper Corp. ("Algo Grande" or the "Company") (TSXV:ALGR)(OTCID:ALGRF)(FRA:KM00) announces that in response to strong demand, it has upsized its previously announced non-brokered private placement (the "Upsized Offering") of common shares in the capital of the Company (the "Shares") originally announced on August 13, 2026.  The Upsized Offering raises the maximum aggregate gross proceeds from the sale of the Shares from $3,000,000 to up to $5,000,000.  The Upsized Offering will now consist of up to 8,333,333 Shares at a price of $0.60 per Share.
